images.prompt: A single zen ensō circle painted in one confident stroke of black sumi ink with a large soft calligraphy brush on plain white paper. The stroke starts thick and wet at the lower left, sweeps clockwise, thins out and breaks into dry-brush streaks (kasure) near the end, leaving a small open gap at the top. Pure flat white background, nothing else on the paper, no seal, no stamp, no signature, no text, no characters, no shadows, no frame. Scanned artwork, high contrast, crisp fibre texture in the dry brush.

Flat overhead macro scan of handmade Japanese kozo washi paper, warm off-white cream colour, long translucent mulberry fibres visible, very subtle cloudy thickness variation, a few tiny darker fibre flecks, perfectly even diffuse lighting, no shadows, no folds, no edges, no objects, fills the entire frame, seamless texture, extremely subtle and low contrast.

Traditional Japanese sumi-e ink painting of a Japanese black pine bonsai in formal upright style in a shallow rectangular pot. Loose confident brushwork, the needle pads rendered as grey ink wash clouds, the trunk in dark dry-brush strokes with flaky bark, a pale ink wash suggests the pot. Black and grey ink only on plain warm white paper, large empty margins, subject centred in the lower two thirds. No seal, no stamp, no calligraphy, no text, no signature, no frame, no border.

Traditional Japanese sumi-e ink painting of an ancient shimpaku juniper bonsai with twisting white deadwood (shari and jin) spiralling up the trunk, a few dense foliage pads, in a small round pot. Loose expressive brushwork, the deadwood left as bare paper outlined by thin ink lines, foliage as soft grey ink washes. Black and grey ink only on plain warm white paper, large empty margins, subject centred. No seal, no stamp, no calligraphy, no text, no signature, no frame, no border.

Traditional Japanese sumi-e ink painting of a satsuki azalea bonsai in full bloom in a shallow oval pot, the gnarled trunk and branches in dark ink, the flower clusters painted as soft dabs of muted vermilion red watercolour, small leaves in grey ink wash. Black ink with a single restrained vermilion accent on plain warm white paper, large empty margins, subject centred. No seal, no stamp, no calligraphy, no text, no signature, no frame, no border.

Traditional Japanese sumi-e ink painting of a tiny shohin chojubai flowering quince bonsai in a small glazed square pot, a knotted miniature trunk with a few thorny twigs and a handful of small blossoms painted in pale coral pink watercolour, tiny leaves in grey ink wash. Mostly black and grey ink on plain warm white paper, very large empty margins, small subject centred low. No seal, no stamp, no calligraphy, no text, no signature, no frame, no border.
